name: github-globe
blurb: 3D spinning globe with animated arcs connecting geographic points.
description: Renders an interactive Three.js globe with lat/lng data points. Arcs animate between start and end locations. Configurable colors, atmosphere, rotation speed, and ring effects.
use_when: Displaying global connections, distributed teams, or data flows between regions.
avoid_when: Performance-critical mobile contexts or when static map suffices.
a11y: 3D visualization is visual-only. No keyboard interaction or descriptive labels.
